title: 1998 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: Dots are spaced one unit apart, horizontally and vertically. The number of square units enclosed by the polygon is

solutions.text:
Consider the \(2 \times 3\) rectangle on the bottom. The triangular piece above that rectangle has the same area as the missing triangular piece below it. Rearranging one into the other gives a full \(2 \times 3\) rectangle, so the polygon’s area is \(6.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: Move the slanted top triangle into the missing bottom space.
The polygon has the area of a \(2\times 3\) rectangle.
